<!--
  Questions in a split or as cards. Axes: layout (head: the heading and an action beside the disclosures, aside:
  the disclosures beside a help card, media: the disclosures and an action beside a picture, search: a finder
  beside a picture, cards: the questions as cards), cards (grid3, grid4, icons), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Question, FaqSplitLabels } from "./faq-split.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { FaqTab } from "./faq-list.types";

export type FaqSplitProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  items: Question[];
  channels: Feature[];
  topics: FaqTab[];
  labels: FaqSplitLabels;
  layout?: "head" | "aside" | "media" | "search" | "cards";
  cards?: "grid3" | "grid4" | "icons";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import FaqCards from "../components/faq-cards.vue";
import FaqDisclosures from "../components/faq-disclosures.vue";
import FaqFinder from "../components/faq-finder.vue";
import FaqHelp from "../components/faq-help.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  items,
  channels,
  topics,
  labels,
  layout = "head",
  cards = "grid3",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FaqSplitProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <FaqCards :items="items" :labels="labels" :cards="cards" />
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'head')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: 'end', align: 'start' }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Box>
      <Button variant="default" size="default" href="#/contact" data-testid="faq-cta">
        {{ labels.cta }}
      </Button>
    </Box>
    <template #aside>
      <FaqDisclosures :items="items" :name="tpl('{0}-faq', id)" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'aside')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: 'end', align: 'start' }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <FaqDisclosures :items="items" :name="tpl('{0}-faq', id)" />
    <template #aside>
      <FaqHelp :labels="labels" :channels="channels" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'media')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide, align: 'start' }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <FaqDisclosures :items="items" :name="tpl('{0}-faq', id)" />
    <Box>
      <Button variant="default" size="default" href="#/contact" data-testid="faq-cta">
        {{ labels.cta }}
      </Button>
    </Box>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-if="((layout as string) === 'search')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <FaqFinder :items="items" :labels="labels" :topics="topics" />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
